lines.text: [warm] Your site has problems you can't see. Google sees every one. Here's how the Technical Audit works.
This is the Technical Audit. Ryze crawls your site the way Google and ChatGPT do — three hundred pages, dozens of checks — and turns what it finds into one health score.
Three things feed it. Page speed — how fast real visitors see your pages. LLM optimization — whether AI assistants can read and quote your site. And SEO — the classics: meta tags, links, canonicals.
Below, every problem found. Site-wide first — this site is missing an L L M S file, and its robots file blocks AI crawlers. That's invisible in a browser, and it quietly keeps you out of AI answers.
Then page by page. Open any row — and every issue comes with a severity, and a fix explained in plain words. The checks it passed are crossed out below.
Now the good part. You don't fix any of this by hand. [curious] Hit fix with agent.
The agent takes the audit, plans the work, and applies the fixes straight through your site — meta tags, redirects, schema, all of it. You just watch.
When it's done, run the scan again. [pause] Sixty two to eighty four. The rings turn green.
So — scan, open the rows you care about, let the agent do the fixing, and scan again. [smiling] Your site stays readable for Google and for ChatGPT. That's the whole job.
